subject: Finova - Decision criteria follow-up (latency / cost / deployment / SLOs)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finova.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finova.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finova - Decision criteria follow-up (latency / cost / deployment / SLOs)

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions and context on where Finova is heading. Per our discussion, I captured the key decision areas and next steps so we have alignment before scheduling the technical deep dive. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Key decision criteria we discussed:
- Latency targets: P95 user-facing inference latency target (you mentioned aiming for ~200-300ms depending on flow)
- Cost target: internal budget guardrail; want to understand per-1M-token or per-API-call estimates across Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
- Deployment: preference for VPC/private deployment due to data controls, but open to dedicated-hosted tradeoffs for time-to-production
- SLA / uptime: procurement will want an SLA; you mentioned 99.9%+ for production-critical endpoints
- Security / compliance: SOC 2 evidence, network topology, SSO & key management requirements

As agreed, next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer(s) and procurement contact for contracting?
2) Can you confirm the target latency P95 and rough monthly usage (requests / tokens) so I can model cost and candidate model choices?
3) If private/VPC is required, we will surface lead times and an initial architecture; if hosted is acceptable for canary traffic we can propose a hybrid rollout.
4) We'll send SOC2 summary + SSO architecture and a draft mutual action plan for review.

Attached: redwood-decision-criteria-template.pdf (short form to capture decision requirements)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 30-min follow-up if helpful.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova - Decision criteria follow-up (latency / cost / deployment / SLOs)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

Economic buyer / stakeholders:
- Raj Patel (CTO) — primary economic buyer (cc'd)
- Emily Stone (Head of AI) — product/feature owner
- Procurement: procurement@finova.com (copied)
- Security reviewer: Lina Gomez (lina.gomez@finova.com) — will be involved in the evidence review

Initial decision targets / constraints:
- Latency: for the customer-facing summarization flow we're targeting P95 < 250ms; for backend batch scoring we're more flexible (up to ~1s)
- Cost: target is to keep inference spend below $2k/month for the pilot (we can provide token estimates after the next internal sizing call)
- Deployment: strong preference for VPC/private deployment for production; can start with hosted for early testing if there's an isolated environment
- SLA: procurement will push for at least 99.9% availability and clear incident escalation paths

Next steps from Finova:
- I'll confirm exact monthly usage numbers by Friday so you can provide cost modeling.
- I'll introduce Lina Gomez to the thread for security questionnaire coordination.

Thanks — appreciate the template, will review and come back with answers.

Best,
Emily
Head of AI, Finova
emily.stone@finova.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finova.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova - Decision criteria follow-up (latency / cost / deployment / SLOs)

Looping in Connor O'Brien from our security/solutions team to help with the SOC 2 / network & SSO questions. Connor — quick summary from the thread: Finova prefers VPC/private deployment for production, P95 target ~250ms for UI flows, pilot budget ~ $2k/month, procurement will request 99.9%+ SLA. 

Connor, can you please: 
- Share a short SOC2 summary and typical evidence items we provide?
- Provide a simple VPC architecture diagram for a private deployment (we can adapt to Finova's cloud) and list lead times (we generally see 3-6 weeks depending on capacity & contract)
- Call out any blockers for bringing up a dedicated pool vs private control plane (ops/regulatory items)

Connor O'Brien's reply (inline):

> From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
> Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:11:00 -0700
>
> Thanks — attaching the SOC2_summary.pdf and a short SSO/architecture PNG. High level: we provide SOC2 type II report for our control plane and can supply a summary of evidence items (user access logs, change control, incident response). For private deployment we run a customer-managed control plane in the VPC and support KMS/HSM integrations; typical lead time is 4-6 weeks once contract and infra access are in place.
>
> For SLAs: our Dedicated offering supports 99.95% uptime commitments; Hosted has an operational SLA but the VPC/private contract will have tailored terms based on capacity/dedicated pools. We'll note any additional audit items requested by Finova and scope them in the mutual action plan.

Lauren continuing: Connor will also be available for a technical call next week — can you share a few times?

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, redwood-sso-arch.png

—
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finova.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova - Decision criteria follow-up (latency / cost / deployment / SLOs)

Thanks Marissa and team — this is helpful and aligns with our internal notes. Quick notes and asks: 

- We'll target P95 < 250ms for the UI pilot and will provide token/usage estimates by EOD Monday so you can run pricing scenarios.
- Procurement would like to see a side-by-side cost estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (include lead time and any up-front infra/setup fees).
- Security (Lina) will review the SOC2 summary; Lina, please advise if you need anything else to start the questionnaire.
- Can you send an initial mutual action plan (timeline + owners) and a draft commercial (ballpark pricing + any pilot discounts)? That will help us get approvals from Raj and procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — propose a 60-min technical call next Wed (21 Jul) at 10am PT if that works for Connor and the ops folks.

Best,
Emily
